facts.text: R1Base-v0 is registered to galaxea_sim.envs.base.bimanual_manipulation:BimanualManipulationEnv with robot_class=R1Robot
BimanualManipulationEnv defaults to control_freq 15, timestep 0.01 s and obs_mode 'image', with obs_mode Literal['state', 'image']
SapienEnv stores the timestep and sets it on the Sapien scene
The action space is the joint-position controller's Box(low=-inf, high=inf, shape=(action_dim,)), and action_dim is the number of left and right arm joints plus two gripper commands
The joint-position controller takes the action as left arm targets, one left gripper target, right arm targets and one right gripper target, in that order
step() sets the joint drive targets, runs decimation scene steps and returns observation, reward, terminated, truncated and info

The state observation contains upper-body joint positions and velocities, gripper positions, end-effector poses, the last joint-position commands, chassis and torso positions, the language instruction and the object dict
In image mode the observation adds an rgb_<camera> and a depth_<camera> array for every camera
The base environment returns empty info and reset info and never terminates or truncates
reset(seed, options) sets the robot qpos to init_qpos, resets the controller and the world, and returns the observation and reset info; seed and options are accepted but unused
The R1 URDF defines a four-joint torso, six joints per arm and two gripper finger joints per hand as non-fixed joints
The environment's dt is 1/control_freq and decimation is int(dt/timestep)
R1's cameras are a 1280x720 head camera and two 320x240 wrist cameras
SapienEnv.close releases only the viewer when one exists

determinism.notes: reset(seed) and cap.world.seed.v1 accept a seed, but the upstream reset does not use it (galaxea_sim/envs/base/bimanual_manipulation.py:159-164); the fake starts from a fixed placeholder state, so a rerun with the same actions repeats the same state hashes

gaps: kinematic F0 stand-in only: no Sapien rigid-body dynamics, contacts, friction, gravity, actuator, sensor, controller or noise model; the commanded joint targets are copied into the observation and the robot never moves through physics

the upstream default obs_mode is 'image' and would add rgb_ and depth_ arrays for the head and wrist cameras (1280x720 and 320x240 for R1); the driver configures obs_mode='state' and the fake models no cameras, so NOT COVERED: the camera rgb_* and depth_* image arrays
the fake was never compared with the upstream Sapien environment, so trajectories and end-effector poses can differ from an upstream run
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0; a tick advances simulated time only

one cap.world.step tick is one environment control step. The upstream step() runs decimation = int((1/control_freq)/timestep) = 6 scene steps of 10 ms, i.e. 60 ms per tick, while timestep_ms names the physics step (10 ms); the Gymnasium bridge carries no separate control-period field (FID-015)
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state/set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
